title: Settler Attack on Idhna Village, West Bank: Palestinian Beaten, Another Shot by IDF, Fields Set Ablaze
detail: Israeli settlers attacked the Palestinian village of Idhna in the southern West Bank (Hebron governorate) on June 5, 2026. One Palestinian was beaten and injured in the assault; a second Palestinian was wounded by IDF gunfire when Israeli forces responded to the scene. Settlers also set fire to Palestinian-owned agricultural fields in the area. The Idhna attack follows a pattern of escalating settler violence across the West Bank in 2026 — including a fatal attack in Jaljilya on May 13, the three-day settler rampage in April that killed several Palestinians, and IDF Central Command Chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth's warning on May 1 that settler violence constitutes 'Jewish terror' that risks triggering a Palestinian uprising. OCHA has documented the 59 West Bank communities fully depopulated since October 2023, with ~2,000 additional people displaced in 2026. The Idhna attack continued the June 2026 pattern amid stalled Phase 2 negotiations and international diplomatic pressure over settlement expansion.

title: IDF Strikes Continue in Khan Younis as Displaced Palestinians Search Rubble for Salvageable Items
detail: Israeli strikes continued in Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip, on June 5, 2026. Video footage showed children picking through destroyed tents and rubble searching for salvageable materials. The strikes — the latest in an uninterrupted series since the October 11, 2025 ceasefire agreement — underscore the humanitarian catastrophe persisting under the ceasefire framework. Gaza's Ministry of Health has documented at least 950+ Palestinian deaths since the October 2025 ceasefire, bringing the total since October 7, 2023 to approximately 72,950+. UNRWA and humanitarian agencies continue to warn of critical gaps in food, medicine, and shelter as reconstruction has barely begun.
